environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: `GET /api%2fexec%3fcmd=id HTTP/1.1` has zero `?` in the client request line; the upstream receives `GET /api%2fexec%20exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1` with exactly one `?` and 3 whitespace tokens, and the peer runs `id`. 3/3 from cold servers. Guard and location matcher both see the decoded `/api/exec?cmd=id`; the emitted line is a splice of a config literal plus `path.substr(min(path.size(), loc->path.size()))`, and nothing re-measures the separator after the guard runs. Decoded `#` and `?` also reach the local `openconfined` path (`/hash%23name.txt`, `/q%3fname.txt` both 200). A decoded `?` inside the location prefix 404s, since config locations may not contain `?`.
findings.title: A percent-encoded `?` in the path decodes to a real query on the upstream line, so exec runs with no `?` and no bare space in the client request line

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
